+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import gzip
+import threading
+from io import BytesIO
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils import urls
+
+
+CONTENT = b'{"message": "a response much longer than the compressed body"}' * 20
+compressed = BytesIO()
+with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=compressed, mode='wb') as writer:
+    writer.write(CONTENT)
+COMPRESSED = compressed.getvalue()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def server():
+    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            self.send_response(200)
+            if self.path == '/gzip':
+                body = COMPRESSED
+                self.send_header('Content-Encoding', 'gzip')
+            else:
+                body = CONTENT
+            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
+            self.send_header('X-Custom', 'value')
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(body)
+
+        def log_message(self, *args):
+            pass
+
+    instance = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Handler)
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=instance.serve_forever)
+    thread.daemon = True
+    thread.start()
+    yield 'http://127.0.0.1:%s' % instance.server_port
+    instance.shutdown()
+    thread.join()
+    instance.server_close()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('path,decompress,expected', [
+    ('/gzip', True, CONTENT),
+    ('/gzip', False, COMPRESSED),
+    ('/plain', True, CONTENT),
+    ('/plain', False, CONTENT),
+])
+def test_open_url_stream(server, path, decompress, expected):
+    response = urls.open_url(server + path, decompress=decompress)
+    try:
+        assert response.read() == expected
+    finally:
+        response.close()
+
+
+def test_fetch_url_headers(server):
+    class Module:
+        params = {}
+        tmpdir = None
+
+    response, info = urls.fetch_url(Module(), server + '/gzip')
+    try:
+        assert response.read() == CONTENT
+        assert info['content-encoding'] == 'gzip'
+        assert info['x-custom'] == 'value'
+        assert 'X-Custom' not in info
+    finally:
+        response.close()
+
+
+def test_reader_closes_underlying_stream():
+    stream = BytesIO(COMPRESSED)
+    reader = urls.GzipDecodedReader(stream)
+    assert reader.read() == CONTENT
+    reader.close()
+    assert stream.closed
+
+
+def test_missing_gzip_is_actionable(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(urls, 'HAS_GZIP', False)
+    with pytest.raises(urls.MissingModuleError) as error:
+        urls.Request().open('GET', 'http://example.invalid/')
+    assert error.value.module == 'gzip'
+    assert 'gzip' in str(error.value)
+
+
+def test_fetch_url_disables_missing_gzip(mocker):
+    class Module:
+        params = {}
+        tmpdir = None
+        deprecate = mocker.Mock()
+
+    mocker.patch.object(urls, 'HAS_GZIP', False)
+    open_url = mocker.patch.object(urls, 'open_url')
+    urls.fetch_url(Module(), 'http://example.invalid/')
+    assert open_url.call_args[1]['decompress'] is False
+    Module.deprecate.assert_called_once_with(urls.GzipDecodedReader.missing_gzip_error(), version='2.16')
